package registration

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
	"time"

	inventory "go.datum.net/fleet/internal/api/inventory/v1alpha1"
	metal "go.datum.net/fleet/internal/api/v1alpha1"
	"go.datum.net/fleet/internal/controller"
	iam "go.miloapis.com/milo/pkg/apis/iam/v1alpha1"
	admissionregistrationv1 "k8s.io/api/admissionregistration/v1"
	authorizationv1 "k8s.io/api/authorization/v1"
	corev1 "k8s.io/api/core/v1"
	metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"
	"k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/runtime"
	"k8s.io/client-go/rest"
	"sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client"
	"sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/envtest"
	"sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/webhook/admission"
	"sigs.k8s.io/yaml"
)

func TestReviewRealNoopAndOutage(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS") == "" {
		t.Skip("KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS required")
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	environment := &envtest.Environment{CRDDirectoryPaths: []string{filepath.Join("..", "..", "config", "base", "crd"), filepath.Join("..", "..", "config", "components", "inventory", "crds")}, ErrorIfCRDPathMissing: true}
	config, err := environment.Start()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if err := environment.Stop(); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	})
	scheme := runtime.NewScheme()
	for _, add := range []func(*runtime.Scheme) error{corev1.AddToScheme, inventory.AddToScheme, metal.AddToScheme, admissionregistrationv1.AddToScheme, authorizationv1.AddToScheme} {
		if err := add(scheme); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	api, err := client.New(config, client.Options{Scheme: scheme})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	device := &inventory.Device{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "noop-hardware", Namespace: "default"}, Spec: inventory.DeviceSpec{ClaimRef: inventory.LocalReference{Name: "installation"}, Identity: inventory.DeviceIdentity{Model: "test", Serial: "noop-serial", SystemUUID: "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"}}}
	if err := api.Create(ctx, device, client.FieldOwner("review")); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	encoded, _ := json.Marshal(Ledger{Authority: "milo", Projects: []string{"provider"}})
	if err := api.Create(ctx, &corev1.Secret{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: LedgerName, Namespace: "default"}, Data: map[string][]byte{"ledger.json": encoded}}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	handler := &Handler{Store: Store{Client: api, Namespace: "default", Authority: "milo", Projects: []string{"provider"}}, VerifyFence: func(ctx context.Context) error { return VerifyFence(ctx, api) }, Resolve: func(context.Context, string) (Project, error) {
		return Project{Identity: controller.ProjectIdentity{AuthorityID: "milo", RouteName: "provider", UID: "project-1"}, Client: api}, nil
	}, Authorize: Authorize}
	server := httptest.NewTLSServer(&admission.Webhook{Handler: handler})
	t.Cleanup(server.Close)
	data, err := os.ReadFile("../../config/components/registration-admission/webhook.yaml")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var webhooks admissionregistrationv1.ValidatingWebhookConfiguration
	if err := yaml.UnmarshalStrict(data, &webhooks); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	url := server.URL
	webhooks.Webhooks[0].ClientConfig = admissionregistrationv1.WebhookClientConfig{URL: &url, CABundle: pemCertificate(server.Certificate().Raw)}
	if err := api.Create(ctx, &webhooks); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	actorConfig := rest.CopyConfig(config)
	actorConfig.Impersonate = rest.ImpersonationConfig{UserName: "review-operator", UID: "actor-1", Groups: []string{"system:masters"}, Extra: map[string][]string{iam.ParentKindExtraKey: {"Project"}, iam.ParentAPIGroupExtraKey: {"resourcemanager.miloapis.com"}, iam.ParentNameExtraKey: {"provider"}}}
	actor, err := client.New(actorConfig, client.Options{Scheme: scheme})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	deadline := time.Now().Add(10 * time.Second)
	for {
		if err := actor.Update(ctx, device.DeepCopyObject().(*inventory.Device), client.DryRunAll); err != nil {
			break
		}
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			t.Fatal("webhook did not engage")
		}
		time.Sleep(30 * time.Millisecond)
	}
	t.Run("successful-noop-must-not-poison-current-device", func(t *testing.T) {
		unchanged := false
		for attempt := 0; attempt < 3; attempt++ {
			if err := actor.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKeyFromObject(device), device); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			before := device.ResourceVersion
			if err := actor.Update(ctx, device, client.FieldOwner("review")); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if before == device.ResourceVersion {
				unchanged = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !unchanged {
			t.Fatal("could not reproduce a no-op update")
		}
		request := registrationRequest(t, device, "after-noop")
		var capacity metal.MachineCapacity
		if err := json.Unmarshal(request.Object.Raw, &capacity); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		capacity.UID = ""
		if err := actor.Create(ctx, &capacity); err != nil {
			t.Errorf("completed no-op left current RV %s ineligible: %v", device.ResourceVersion, err)
		}
	})
	t.Run("explicit-real-edit-control-restores-registration", func(t *testing.T) {
		if err := actor.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKeyFromObject(device), device); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		before := device.ResourceVersion
		device.Labels = map[string]string{"review-control": "real-change"}
		if err := actor.Update(ctx, device, client.FieldOwner("review")); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if device.ResourceVersion == before {
			t.Fatal("control edit did not change RV")
		}
		request := registrationRequest(t, device, "after-real-edit")
		var capacity metal.MachineCapacity
		if err := json.Unmarshal(request.Object.Raw, &capacity); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		capacity.UID = ""
		if err := actor.Create(ctx, &capacity); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("explicitly reselected changed Device should register: %v", err)
		}
		if err := handler.Recover(ctx); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		_, ledger, err := handler.Store.Read(ctx)
		if err != nil || len(ledger.Entries) != 1 || ledger.Entries[0].Outcome != "Recorded" {
			t.Fatalf("control failed: %+v %v", ledger, err)
		}
	})
	t.Run("out-of-scope-inventory-outage-blast-radius", func(t *testing.T) {
		outsideConfig := rest.CopyConfig(actorConfig)
		outsideConfig.Impersonate.Extra = map[string][]string{iam.ParentKindExtraKey: {"Project"}, iam.ParentAPIGroupExtraKey: {"resourcemanager.miloapis.com"}, iam.ParentNameExtraKey: {"unrelated-consumer"}}
		outside, err := client.New(outsideConfig, client.Options{Scheme: scheme})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		other := device.DeepCopyObject().(*inventory.Device)
		other.Name, other.UID, other.ResourceVersion, other.ManagedFields = "outside-before-outage", "", "", nil
		if err := outside.Create(ctx, other); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		server.Close()
		other.Name, other.UID, other.ResourceVersion, other.ManagedFields = "outside-after-outage", "", "", nil
		if err := outside.Create(ctx, other); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("expected packaged fail-closed webhook to block unrelated inventory too")
		} else {
			t.Logf("confirmed unrelated project inventory outage: %v", err)
		}
	})
}
